(MTCO) has grown into a trusted supplier and distributor of advanced security and automation technologies across Lebanon, Nigeria, and beyond. As a Hikvision dealer partner, we deliver world-class surveillance, access control, lighting, audio, and communication solutions that empower both businesses and individuals to protect what matters most. With a dedicated team of professionals and a portfolio spanning military, ministerial, banking, hospitality, education, and corporate sectors, MTCO combines innovation with reliability. Our commitment goes beyond providing systems—we strive to create safer communities, smarter environments, and peace of mind for our clients through tailored solutions and continuous support. Our Mission MTCO offers advanced security solutions to fulfill the changing needs of clients in a world where security is crucial for businesses and individuals. Our Commitment to Excellence Melhem Trading Co aims to provide innovative and efficient security solutions to its clients while upholding quality in all its endeavors. Empowering Safety and Peace of Mind The company’s goal is to help clients take control of their security and feel safe and secure by providing information and resources beyond selling security systems. Contributing to a Safer World The company values the impact of security systems on communities, public places, and the environment. They seek to collaborate with organizations, law enforcement, and industry partners to promote best practices, encourage innovation, and raise security standards. MTCO > Services Customized Solutions Highlight the ability to deliver customized CCTV solutions geared to clients’ individual needs, whether it’s a single camera setup or a complex system covering numerous sites. System Scalability Emphasize the scalability of the systems you provide. Your solutions should be versatile, whether clients need to start small and expand later or demand a comprehensive system from the start. Remote Control Highlight the possibility for clients to remotely monitor your properties. This might incorporate mobile app access, which allows customers to see live video and receive notifications on their devices. Existing System Integration Mention the capacity to interface the CCTV system with other security or IT systems that the customer may already have in place, if relevant. Lighting Solutions Pioneers MTCO is a major force in the lighting sector, with a wealth of knowledge spanning several years. Our dedication to quality has established us as the go-to firm for all of your lighting requirements, making us a well-known brand in the industry. Comprehensive Lighting Services We handle every part of the lighting spectrum, from lighting distribution to accessories. Our complete variety of services means that we are more than simply a provider; we are your entire partner in properly illuminating areas.
